ctx.title: Ramayana Worldwide Box Office Day 10 (Early Trends): Yash Delivers The Highest-Grossing Film Of His Career, Destroying KGF: Chapter 2!
ctx.summary:
Yash gets the highest grossing film of his career globally as he surpasses lifetime total of KGF 2 - day 10 worldwide early trends. 
 The post  Ramayana Worldwide Box Office Day 10 (Early Trends): Yash Delivers The Highest-Grossing Film Of His Career, Destroying KGF: Chapter 2!  appeared first on  Koimoi .
ctx.text:
Four years after KGF: Chapter 2 turned Rocking Star Yash into a pan-India phenomenon with its lifetime gross collection of 1,228.59 crore in its lifetime run, the superstar has officially outdone himself. The celebratory news is: he needed just 10 days to pull off a historic turnaround in his career! Fuelled by a monstrous Second Saturday domestic surge and a rock-solid gross collection globally, the film has hit a historic record!
From overseas markets on Day 10, Nitesh Tiwari’s Ramayana: Part 1, starring Ranbir Kapoor and Sai Pallavi, has rocketed to an estimated 1233 – 1234 crore gross collection worldwide! In a single stroke, Yash has shattered his own career-best global benchmark to claim the biggest worldwide grosser of his filmography.
Meanwhile, Ramayana has pushed itself straight to the #7 spot among the all-time highest-grossing Indian films globally! By crossing 1,233 crore in just 10 days, Ramayana has already dethroned Pathaan, Jawa, and KGF: Chapter 2 , setting its sights squarely on SS Rajamouli’s RRR.
Playing the iconic antagonist Ravana opposite Ranbir Kapoor’s Lord Ram, Yash has shattered his own career-best record set by KGF: Chapter 2 (1,228.59 crore) in just 10 days. Remarkably, Yash now headlines two of the Top 8 highest-grossing Indian films of all time!
Breaching 1233 – 1234 crore worldwide in just 10 days and dethroning KGF: Chapter 2 to become the biggest global blockbuster of Yash’s career, Ramayana: Part 1 is rewriting every box office parameter in Indian cinema. With a massive Second Sunday lined up tomorrow, the march toward the 1500 crore club is officially underway!
